messages:
anya: looping in SEs to lock down the Acme POC scope. customer wants a 2-week POC: RAG Q&A + long-form summary generator. need prompt inventory, baseline prompts, and success criteria by EOD Wed. @matt can you confirm compute/pricing? @jonas can you draft seed prompts + eval plan?

matt: can do. for an initial hosted run we can start on 4xT4 equiv or 1xA10G equivalent for dev. for production-ish load (concurrent 8 req/s) recommend 2xA100 or a small dedicated slot. rough pricing: hosted ~ $900/week, dedicated reserve estimate ~$1.6k/week. will validate after we size token/seq distribution.

jonas: draft prompts and quick eval plan below. keeping these minimal for the POC so we can iterate fast. acceptance criteria suggestion: p50 latency < 300ms, QA exact/f1 >= 0.78, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.6, and no PII leaks in top-5 outputs. also require SSO + data retention policy agreed.

jonas: ```
# QA prompt v1
You are an assistant that answers user questions using the provided document context. If the answer is not in the docs, say "I don't know."
Context: <DOCUMENTS>
Question: "<USER_QUESTION>"
Answer concisely with citations like [doc-3:23-27].

# Summary prompt v1
Summarize the provided document(s) in 3-4 bullet points. Preserve factual claims and include a 1-line TL;DR. Redact any PII (replace with [REDACTED]).

# Rewriting prompt v1
Rewrite the highlighted paragraph to be suitable for executive audience, keeping technical meaning.
```

anya: Acme explicitly asked for PII redaction, SOC2-ish controls, and weekly eval outputs. they want the full prompt inventory + sample responses before demo. timeline: they will deliver 100 sample QA pairs and 50 docs by Mon. we need a run and the first eval by end of next week.

matt: noted. for RAG we'll enable prefix caching and a small KV cache; that should reduce token compute. hosting vs dedicated: recommend hosted for initial two sprints -> faster onboarding and cheaper ops, move to dedicated if throughput/SLAs require it. model rec: start with mid-size MPT/Llama-3 variant quantized, then test LLM family swaps during eval.

sara (Acme): thanks, that plan sounds good. confirming we'll provide the dataset by Monday EOD. can you share a simple checklist of what you need (format, labels, privacy)? also prefer p50 <500ms but can compromise if accuracy is high. weekly digest is great.

anya: checklist: docs as PDFs or text, 100 Q/A as CSV with columns: id, question, answer, source_doc_id, sensitive_flag. include a short label set for intent (faq, support, sales). privacy: mark any PII rows with sensitive_flag=1; we'll redact in pipeline. i'll send a sample CSV template.

jonas: adding brief eval harness plan: run 100 gold Qs through baseline prompts, compute F1/EM and produce 10 example model outputs per prompt. run summary ROUGE and a PII-detection pass. we'll post results to the POC dashboard and attach sample logs.

deploy-bot: POC env created: poc-acme-1719901234. link: https://internal.redwood/pocs/poc-acme-1719901234 (permissions: anya, matt, jonas, sara).

anya: scheduling: quick sync Tue morning to review seed prompts, Thu demo for first batch outputs. i'll update the PRD and share invites. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

matt: i'll circle back with a refined cost estimate after we get token distribution.

jonas: will push prompt variations and evaluation notebook to the poc repo by Tue.

sara (Acme): great — speak Tue. appreciate the quick turnaround.
